cases.title: Clicking Add note creates and appends a note with a textarea
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Add note button creates a new note appended to the document body as a div element with the class note, containing a visible, empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that multiple rapid clicks on the Add note button successfully create separate notes, each containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Markdown input and real-time rendering
cases.description: Verify that when the user types Markdown into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in real-time within the main display area (data-testid="note-main") with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown without crashing
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown does not cause crashes or errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Immediate local storage persistence during editing
cases.description: Verify that all changes made while editing markdown content are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: New note creation enters edit mode
cases.description: Verify that when a user creates a new note by clicking the Add note button, the note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea is visible and the main content area remains hidden.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the Edit button, which toggles the visibility of the textarea and the main content area accordingly.

cases.title: Automatic saving to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage to preserve the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and Display Saved Notes from LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates a div element with the class note containing the tools div with Edit and Delete buttons, main div, and textarea, and displays stored notes with their content in the main div while hiding the textarea by default.

cases.title: Display Textarea and Hide Main Div for Empty Notes on Load
cases.description: Verify that for notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div, allowing immediate editing.

cases.title: Empty LocalStorage Shows No Notes
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage is empty, no notes are shown on the webpage.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors have corresponding test cases. No blockers or missing scenarios were found.
All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their specified behaviors, normal paths, and states without any blockers or missing explicit scenarios.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the Add note button creates and appends a note div to the document body, each note contains a visible empty textarea, and the application supports multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes each with its own textarea. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: textarea accepts markdown input/modification, content dynamically renders in note-main in real-time, complex/invalid markdown handles without crashing, exiting edit mode via the Edit button displays raw input for invalid markdown, and changes reflect immediately in local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: creating a new note on page load or click, newly created note enters edit mode with visible textarea and hidden main content area, switching between edit and view modes via Edit button toggles visibility of textarea and main content area, and changes typed into textarea are automatically saved to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: deleting a note by clicking the Delete button removes the targeted note immediately from the DOM, and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: loading webpage retrieves and displays saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates note div containing tools div with Edit and Delete buttons, main div, and textarea for each note, rendered notes with content show main div with hidden textarea by default, notes with no content show textarea and hide main div, empty localStorage shows no notes, and internal notes variable uses JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')).
